item.title: Stand Together
item.description: When residents ask their leaders to speak, they are not asking for a legal explanation of what cannot be done. They are asking for reassurance about who we are and what we can expect as far as protection from our local law enforcement. The post Stand Together appeared first on The Santa Barbara Independent.

item.title: Standing Up for Our Neighbors, Our Rights, and Our Constitution
